evidence.section: 4.2 Interaction between dislocations and B2 nanoclusters in Nb40 alloy
evidence.quote: The B2 structures in the Nb40_1M sample act as coherent nanoprecipitates, and their strengthening mechanism resembles precipitate strengthening.

A neural network regression of Spectral Neighbor Analysis Potential (NN-SNAP), developed for the MoNbTaW alloy system [38], has been utilized to conduct the atomistic simulations in this study using LAMMPS software.
